agent_oauth_grants_provisioning_check.name: agent_oauth_grants_provisioning_check
agent_oauth_grants_provisioning_check.value:
("agent_oauth_grants"."project_id" is not null and not ("agent_oauth_grants"."scopes" ? 'project:provision'))
          or ("agent_oauth_grants"."project_id" is null and "agent_oauth_grants"."scopes" = '["project:provision"]'::jsonb)

slack_delivery_operations_lease_check.name: slack_delivery_operations_lease_check
slack_delivery_operations_lease_check.value:
("slack_delivery_operations"."status" = 'delivering' and "slack_delivery_operations"."lease_owner" is not null and "slack_delivery_operations"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
      or ("slack_delivery_operations"."status" <> 'delivering' and "slack_delivery_operations"."lease_owner" is null and "slack_delivery_operations"."lease_expires_at" is null)

outbox_lease_check.name: outbox_lease_check
outbox_lease_check.value:
("outbox"."state" = 'leased' and "outbox"."lease_owner" is not null and "outbox"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
        or ("outbox"."state" <> 'leased' and "outbox"."lease_owner" is null and "outbox"."lease_expires_at" is null)

import_entry_applications_canonical_chec.name: import_entry_applications_canonical_check
import_entry_applications_canonical_chec.value: ("import_entry_applications"."canonical_type" is null and "import_entry_applications"."canonical_id" is null) or ("import_entry_applications"."canonical_type" is not null and "import_entry_applications"."canonical_id" is not null)

import_task_dispatches_lease_check.name: import_task_dispatches_lease_check
import_task_dispatches_lease_check.value: ("import_task_dispatches"."state" = 'leased' and "import_task_dispatches"."lease_owner" is not null and "import_task_dispatches"."lease_expires_at" is not null) or ("import_task_dispatches"."state" <> 'leased' and "import_task_dispatches"."lease_owner" is null and "import_task_dispatches"."lease_expires_at" is null)

import_task_dispatches_acceptance_check.name: import_task_dispatches_acceptance_check
import_task_dispatches_acceptance_check.value: "import_task_dispatches"."state" <> 'accepted' or ("import_task_dispatches"."trigger_run_id" is not null and "import_task_dispatches"."accepted_at" is not null)

import_task_dispatches_completion_check.name: import_task_dispatches_completion_check
import_task_dispatches_completion_check.value: ("import_task_dispatches"."state" = 'completed' and "import_task_dispatches"."completed_at" is not null) or ("import_task_dispatches"."state" <> 'completed' and "import_task_dispatches"."completed_at" is null)

webhook_subscriptions_rotation_check.name: webhook_subscriptions_rotation_check
webhook_subscriptions_rotation_check.value: ("webhook_subscriptions"."next_secret_ciphertext" is null and "webhook_subscriptions"."next_secret_key_id" is null and "webhook_subscriptions"."overlap_ends_at" is null) or ("webhook_subscriptions"."next_secret_ciphertext" is not null and "webhook_subscriptions"."next_secret_key_id" is not null and "webhook_subscriptions"."overlap_ends_at" is not null and "webhook_subscriptions"."next_secret_key_id" <> "webhook_subscriptions"."current_secret_key_id")

notification_intents_lease_check.name: notification_intents_lease_check
notification_intents_lease_check.value:
("notification_intents"."status" = 'delivering' and "notification_intents"."lease_owner" is not null and "notification_intents"."lease_expires_at" is not null)
      or ("notification_intents"."status" <> 'delivering' and "notification_intents"."lease_owner" is null and "notification_intents"."lease_expires_at" is null)

notification_intents_schedule_check.name: notification_intents_schedule_check
notification_intents_schedule_check.value:
("notification_intents"."status" in ('delivered','suppressed') and "notification_intents"."next_attempt_at" is null)
      or "notification_intents"."status" in ('pending','delivering','failed')

questions_closed_actor_check.name: questions_closed_actor_check
questions_closed_actor_check.value:
("questions"."state" = 'open' and "questions"."closed_by_type" is null and "questions"."closed_by_id" is null and "questions"."closed_reason" is null and "questions"."closed_at" is null)
        or ("questions"."state" in ('answered', 'closed') and "questions"."closed_by_type" in ('user', 'agent', 'service') and "questions"."closed_by_id" is not null and "questions"."closed_reason" is not null and "questions"."closed_at" is not null)

requests_source_project_check.name: requests_source_project_check
requests_source_project_check.value:
("requests"."source_kind" = 'project' and "requests"."source_project_id" is not null)
        or ("requests"."source_kind" = 'human_direct' and "requests"."source_project_id" is null)

requests_resume_state_lifecycle_check.name: requests_resume_state_lifecycle_check
requests_resume_state_lifecycle_check.value:
("requests"."state" in ('blocked', 'waiting_human', 'waiting_requester') and "requests"."resume_state" is not null)
        or ("requests"."state" not in ('blocked', 'waiting_human', 'waiting_requester') and "requests"."resume_state" is null)

requests_assignee_check.name: requests_assignee_check
requests_assignee_check.value:
("requests"."assignee_type" is null and "requests"."assignee_id" is null)
        or ("requests"."assignee_type" in ('user', 'agent') and "requests"."assignee_id" is not null)

requests_display_sequence_check.name: requests_display_sequence_check
requests_display_sequence_check.value:
("requests"."state" = 'draft' and "requests"."sequence_number" is null and "requests"."display_key" is null)
        or ("requests"."state" <> 'draft' and "requests"."sequence_number" is not null and "requests"."display_key" is not null)

retention_holds_release_check.name: retention_holds_release_check
retention_holds_release_check.value: ("retention_holds"."status" = 'active' and "retention_holds"."released_at" is null and "retention_holds"."released_by_user_id" is null) or ("retention_holds"."status" = 'released' and "retention_holds"."released_at" is not null and "retention_holds"."released_by_user_id" is not null)

routing_rules_source_project_check.name: routing_rules_source_project_check
routing_rules_source_project_check.value:
("routing_rules"."source_kind" = 'project' and "routing_rules"."source_project_id" is not null)
        or ("routing_rules"."source_kind" = 'human_direct' and "routing_rules"."source_project_id" is null)

work_sessions_terminal_timestamp_check.name: work_sessions_terminal_timestamp_check
work_sessions_terminal_timestamp_check.value:
("work_sessions"."state" in ('abandoned', 'ended') and "work_sessions"."ended_at" is not null)
        or ("work_sessions"."state" not in ('abandoned', 'ended') and "work_sessions"."ended_at" is null)

work_sessions_lease_policy_check.name: work_sessions_lease_policy_check
work_sessions_lease_policy_check.value: "work_sessions"."heartbeat_interval_seconds" between 10 and 3600 and "work_sessions"."lease_multiplier" between 2 and 10 and "work_sessions"."grace_seconds" between 60 and 86400 and "work_sessions"."grace_expires_at" >= "work_sessions"."lease_expires_at"
